text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the movie theater inside the 
shopping complex, I ran into Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, Maruzen. Heading to a movie now?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm going to watch a super trendy 
love story right now♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a story about an ordinary boy and a 
high-born lady who fall in love and elope 
together. You really can't beat the 
classics, can you?♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh... An elopement, is it?
choice_data_list: Interested?
Are you interested?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. A little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. showed a surprising amount of 
interest. So, the three of us decided to 
watch it together—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~...♪ That was such a lovely story.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was fun! Maybe I'll recommend it 
to my parents sometime.
choice_data_list: Why not give them a movie gift card?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! Maybe I'll make that my souvenir 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Casting aside all obligations to 
choose love. It really is the kind of 
situation one dreams of.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it kinda makes you think. Do you 
think those two were able to find 
happiness after that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're happy, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Instant answer!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Because the people closest to me have 
found happiness, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —My parents eloped, you see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, what a wonderful story♪ And they're 
still head over heels for each other even 
now, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
However... not everyone can walk the same 
path, can they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure every couple is happy the moment 
they elope. But—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Passion always cools down eventually. 
Things like money, or each other's 
flaws... The reality of it all starts 
creeping in—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! My bad, my bad! We just watched such 
a wonderful story, so getting into serious 
talk is a liiittle uncalled for, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. But still, I think it's only 
natural that things take hard work.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if your parents also overcame 
a story full of ups and downs together?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —I actually asked once. When it was 
just me and Mom together.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mom. When you eloped with Dad— was 
there ever a time you felt it was tough?

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, of course. My mom and dad went 
through continuous hardships, and they 
were even cut off from their families back 
home.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ………… Then, have you ever had any regrets?

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think so. Because it was a 
path I freely chose in the truest sense."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In the truest sense? What do you mean by 
that?

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Bound by nothing, making no compromises. 
She chose what her heart truly desired 
most —that is what it means.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe whether you have regrets or not 
just comes down to whether you can pursue 
the answer you truly desire to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Whether you can stay happy or not, too.
choice_data_list: ...I see. Are you happy right now?
...I see. Are you happy right now?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Of course! How could I not be 
happy?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Choosing to run. Coming to this academy. 
And choosing you as my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's everything I ever wanted. I just 
followed my heart and chose without 
hesitation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I've stayed true to real freedom all 
along. There's no way I have any regrets.
choice_data_list: I'd love to stay free from now on too.

We should both keep being free from now 
on.

So it's about whether you can always 
follow your heart, huh?

So it's about whether you can always 
follow your heart, I suppose?
I'd love to hear more about your parents.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I've stayed true to real freedom all 
along. There's no way I have any regrets.
choice_data_list: I'd love to stay free from now on too.

We should both keep being free from now 
on.

So it's about whether you can always 
follow your heart, huh?

So it's about whether you can always 
follow your heart, I suppose?
I'd love to hear more about your parents.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But we shouldn't have to worry for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Because my heart yearns to keep running on 
and on.
choice_data_list: My heart wishes to keep supporting you.
My heart wishes to keep supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That'd be awesome, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What lies beyond the pursuit of absolute 
freedom? —Shall the two of us go find out?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That's a bit tough. Sometimes you 
can't even figure out your own heart or 
what you really want, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Really? I, for one, feel totally 
clearheaded right now.
choice_data_list: So, what do you want to do right now?
So, what do you want to do right now?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You want to chat more and play together 
with all three of us, right? Is that all 
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Abso-lutely♪ Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the three of us enjoyed walking 
around and sharing a meal while talking 
about our thoughts on the movie."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I want to hear that too! Is it okay, 
CB-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! I'll give you plenty to 
listen to.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A story of those who chose freedom—and 
remained happy no matter what happened.
